css: .wc-start,#wc-first{--wc-brand-top:clamp(18px, 5.2vh, 70px);--wc-brand-pad:clamp(0px, (100vh - 680px) * .4, .148 * clamp(250px, 32vw, 520px));--wc-brand-gap:clamp(14px, 2.6vh, 30px);--wc-start-drop:0px}.wc-start-skyhost,.wcf-sky{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0}html.wc-phone .wc-start-skyhost,html.wc-phone .wcf-sky{inset:calc(-1 * (var(--pad,0px) + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))) calc(-1 * (var(--pad,0px) + env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))) calc(-1 * (var(--pad,0px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))) calc(-1 * (var(--pad,0px) + env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)))}.wc-start-brand{left:0;right:0;top:var(--wc-brand-top);padding-top:var(--wc-brand-pad);pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% 0;justify-content:center;display:flex;position:absolute}@media (max-height:560px){.wc-start-brand{display:none}}.wc-start,#wc-first{--wc-panel-w:360px;--wc-panel-h:399px}html.wc-phone .wc-start,html.wc-phone #wc-first{--wc-panel-h:357px}@media (min-width:600px) and (min-height:600px){html.wc-phone .wc-start,html.wc-phone #wc-first{--wc-panel-h:399px;--wc-start-drop:max(0px, (100vh - .283 * clamp(250px, 32vw, 520px) - var(--wc-brand-gap) - var(--wc-panel-h) - 130px) / 2 - var(--wc-brand-top) - var(--wc-brand-pad))}html.wc-phone #wc-first .wc-start-brand,html.wc-phone .wc-start.is-main .wc-start-brand{translate:0 var(--wc-start-drop)}}
